notes: "I want to tell you why I built HUANDENG, rather than list its features. It started in group meetings, with slides that everyone could tell were made by AI, and with agents that turned two small edits into three copies of a deck. HUANDENG is a desktop slide editor where you and an AI agent work on one deck, one page at a time, starting from the story you want to tell. The molecule on the right is the worked example later in the talk: the DNA dodecamer from PDB entry 1BNA."

designIntent.purpose: Name HUANDENG and its purpose; introduce the 1BNA worked example.
